name: Cabin / short-term rental resort
summary: Clusters of 400-900 SF furnished cabins operated as short-term rentals. Cost per key = the cabin (prefab/kit vs. site-built custom is the biggest swing, roughly $80-$500/SF per consumer cost guides) plus per-cabin site infrastructure (septic or sewer, water, power, driveway/parking, decks) and a share of shared amenities. No resort-scale budget was retrieved; the default is a derived build-up from consumer cost guides and the RV/campground infrastructure evidence. Confidence low.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: small STR cabin clusters are 4-12 cabins; branded cabin resorts 20-60. Mid 15.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Bob Vila cites a 500-SF cabin as its national-average benchmark (b1); STR cabins range from 1-bedroom 400 SF to 2-bedroom + loft ~900 SF. Mid 600 SF.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Judgment: privacy-driven spacing (one cabin per 0.2-1 acre) with septic setbacks; denser where on sewer.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: One to two guest vehicles per cabin plus staff; judgment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Cabin + site build-up. Cabin: Bob Vila prefab cabins $80-$230/SF, custom $300-$500/SF, national average $75,000 for a 500-SF cabin (b1, b2). Mid cabin = 600 SF x ~$230/SF (top of prefab / high-finish STR spec) = ~$138k. Per-cabin site work ~$40k: utilities, septic tank ($3,500-$11,100, b3) and drainfield, driveway/parking, deck, share of roads and grading - benchmarked to the full-hookup RV site infrastructure (~$30k-$40k per site, rv e8). Mid = $138k + $40k = ~$180k. Low = 400 SF kit/prefab at ~$150/SF ($60k) + $30k site; high = 800-900 SF custom at ~$350/SF (~$280k) + $70k site (well, engineered septic, long drives).

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit / sfPerPrimaryUnit (90k/400 ~ $225; 180k/600 = $300; 350k/900 ~ $390), rounded; includes per-cabin site work, which is why it sits above the prefab $80-$230/SF building-only range (b2).

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. general conditions and OH&P for the cabin (delivered/assembled or site-built, finished) and per-cabin and shared on-site work (grading, roads, parking, utilities, septic, landscaping). Excludes land, soft costs, FF&E/OS&E, off-site utility extensions, tap/impact fees.

systemSplit.method: Cabin portion (~78%) split per NAHB construction-stage shares (cottage-court k3) mapped to CSI; site portion (~22%) weighted to utilities/septic (33) and roads/parking/decks (32) given rural sites with on-site wastewater.

cost.method: Bob Vila: prefab $80-$230/SF; custom $300-$500/SF; kits $50-$80/SF materials only (b2). Mid at top of prefab range for STR-grade finishes.

lineItems.name: Septic tank and drainfield per cabin (or shared cluster system)

cost.method: Bob Vila septic tank $3,500-$11,100 (b3) plus drainfield/lines; high for engineered/mound systems.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out. Replace with sewer laterals where municipal sewer exists.

lineItems.name: Private hot tub on deck (STR amenity)

cost.method: Judgment: 4-6 person hot tub, dedicated 50A circuit and reinforced deck area.

lineItems.notes: Strong STR revenue driver; often standard in premium tier.

cost.method: Judgment; public water system rules may apply above ~15 connections/25 people.
Judgment: 600-2,500 SF at ~$170-$320/SF; many small STR clusters have none (self check-in).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Judgment: furnishing a 1-2 bedroom STR cabin (beds, linens, kitchenware, living furniture, outdoor furniture, smart lock/TV/Wi-Fi). No source retrieved; verify with STR furnishing packages.

pctOfHard.method: Judgment: prefab/repeat cabin plans lower A&E; septic design, rural entitlements (STR permits, conditional use) and survey add. Mid 15%.

hard.method: Judgment; higher for remote sites (rock, access, perc failure).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min = small prefab cabin + basic site, low soft; max = 900 SF custom cabin ($500/SF, b2) + engineered site + soft costs.

evidence.scopeNotes: Consumer guide dated 2023-07-25. Log cabin range $50,000-$150,000. Foundation: 'The average foundation cost is between $7,000 and $19,000.' Building cost; land and most site utilities excluded.
